_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With zero 12h windows showing ±2+ point score movement over 69 observations, this is a textbook coil where HOLD with conviction is the skilled call — the August 2024 analog tells us what may come next but does not move the current phase up the ladder.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst calls HOLD while the narrative writer implies an impending UP move toward a relief rally; the judge sides with the analyst's statistical base rate and higher trust weight (7.67 vs 6.00).
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed breaks below 25 with VIX spiking above 20 and funding turning negative = Panic leg down
next_move.invalidated_if: btc_momentum_30d clears 60 with stablecoin_growth reversing above 55 and etf_flows turning positive = Hope leg up
